description: Democratic nominee for governor Cindy Holscher held a press conference today outside GoCreate at Wichita State University, calling out Ty Masterson’s million-dollar “no-show job” and the corrupt system that has allowed wealthy special interests to bankroll his career while influencing his work in the Legislature.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Cindy Holscher for Kansas
title: NEW: Holscher calls out Masterson for no-show job in Wichita | Cindy Holscher for Governor
